title: Every Cut You Make (feat. Vivek Ramaswamy)
subtitle: A lonely man writes a song of longing, in the style of the police
body_html:
The Frontier Psychiatrist is mostly a Health themed newsletter, and I promise you, I was working on an article before I did this about a research study, and I'm gonna get back to that.

But—I've been preoccupied. Preoccupied with the state of the world, you ask? No. Preoccupied with somebody dear to all of us. Preoccupied with a man. Preoccupied with a preoccupied man. I've been preoccupied thinking about what ever happened to Vivek Ramaswamy.

I can't stop thinking about how sad Vivek Ramaswamy must be, watching his former colleagues at “DOGE” rip through 30,000 federal employee jobs, and just over 2 billions in “savings.” But, crucially, without him. This was his big chance. It should be him, sleeping on the floor next to Big Balls in the department of agriculture. It should be him, slashing massive budgets that are definitely not part of the CIA budget, and are completely separate. If anyone was gonna oversee young men between the ages of 17 and 22 interviewing career civil servants for their jobs —like the movie office space was an uplifting documentary-it should've been Ramaswamy. Mostly, he misses the team that could've been. I imagine him, sitting, on his piles of pharma money, somewhere in Ohio, wistfully writing songs. This is what is in my mind. It's in my mind every day when I wake up, and every day when I go to sleep. And so today, I'm dropping some of those lyrics, that I imagine Vivek Ramaswamy writing. You, too, can know what goes on in my mind, as I weep, quietly, for the broken heart of a man longing for what could've been.

Share

Every job you take
And every cut you make
Every agency you break
Every piece of vital federal information you take
I'll be watching you

Every single day
And every impulsively thing you say
Every budgetary game you play
Every night you stay (inside of the agency you have no security clearance for)
I'll be watching you

Oh, can't you see
I should have been me?
How my poor ego aches
With every action you take absent my crucial input?

Every move you make
And every employment law you break
Every smile you fake
Every career you break
I'll be watching you

Since I’ve left DOGE, I've been lost without a thought
I scroll X at night, I can only see your initiatives
I look around, but it's me you can't replace
I feel so cold, and I long for attention of the MSM
I keep crying, Elon, Elon please

Oh, can't you see
Attention belongs to me?
How my poor ego aches
With every step you take absent my crucial role?

Every ill-conceived move you make
And every budget you break
Every expertise you fake
Every lib you stake
I'll be watching you
Every additional dollar from a lucrative federal contract you make
Every taxpayer dollar you take
I'll be watching you

I'll be watching you
(Every liberty you take)
(Every glib promise you make)
(Every bond you increase the interest rate on)
(Every step to weaken our federal workforce you take) I'll be watching you

I'll be watching you

I'll be watching you, obsessively

whoo, hoo
(Every game you play, including Diablo IV)
(Every night you stay) I'll be watching you

I'll be watching you (for me)

I'll be watching you, it should have been me

I'll be watching you
(Every single mandatory in-office day)
(Every absurd word you say)
(Every game you play theoretically at a professional level)
(Every night you stay) I'll be watching you on Fox

—Vivek Ramaswamy and what’s left of the Police
